_changelog.author: Claude Sonnet 5
_changelog.what: tsconfig for the neurograph OpenClaw extension, scoped to typecheck index.ts and index.test.ts against ambient stub SDK types.
_changelog.why: SOURCE-LIFECYCLE-REPAIR-SPEC.md Extension tests require the extension to type-check against the installed OpenClaw SDK; no real openclaw npm package is installed in this dev environment, so this project resolves the SDK's type surface from types/openclaw-stub.d.ts instead (see that file's header for the exact scope of the stand-in).
_changelog.how: Modeled on jink-mcp/tsconfig.json (Node16 module/resolution, strict, skipLibCheck).

_changelog.author: Claude Sonnet 5
_changelog.what: Corrective follow-up (Grok family review of 0ac8826): clarified that this config is an isolated compile harness against a stub, not the frozen 'installed SDK' typecheck gate.
_changelog.why: The stub lets tsc run at all with no openclaw package installed, but a clean `tsc --noEmit` here proves index.ts is internally type-consistent with the stub's declared shapes — it does NOT prove compatibility with the real openclaw runtime SDK on the VPS, which this workstream is forbidden from reaching (no SSH/live inspection). That gate stays open for controlled VPS validation.
_changelog.how: Comment-only clarification; no compiler option changes.
